name: Outlook
description: Outlook provides personal and work email through Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Graph.
agentUseSummary: Connect one signed-in Outlook mailbox through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth with OIDC, offline refresh, PKCE, and the exact delegated Mail.Read permission. Four wrappers read the first twenty-five non-hidden root folders, the first twenty-five newest Inbox messages, the first twenty-five newest unread Inbox messages, or one explicit message as at most eight thousand plain-text body characters. Relay blocks shared and application mail, attachments and MIME, search and exports, writes and sends, other Graph workloads, raw endpoints, automatic pagination, and retries.

capabilities.label: List mail folders
capabilities.description: Read non-hidden root folders from the signed-in mailbox.

capabilities.label: Review recent Inbox
capabilities.description: Read bounded newest Inbox message summaries.

capabilities.label: Review unread Inbox
capabilities.description: Read bounded newest unread Inbox message summaries.

capabilities.label: Read message
capabilities.description: Read one explicit message as bounded plain text.

allowed.label: List Outlook mail folders
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five non-hidden root folders in the signed-in mailbox.

allowed.label: List recent Inbox messages
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five newest message summaries from the signed-in user's Inbox.

allowed.label: List unread Inbox messages
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five newest unread message summaries from the signed-in user's Inbox.

allowed.label: Get Outlook message
allowed.description: Read one explicit prior-result message as bounded plain text from the signed-in mailbox.

blocked.label: Access other mailboxes
blocked.description: Shared, delegated other-user, group, application-permission, and tenant-wide mail are blocked.

blocked.label: Access attachments or raw mail
blocked.description: Attachments, MIME, raw headers, unsafe HTML, extensions, and custom properties are blocked.

blocked.label: Search or export mail
blocked.description: Search, arbitrary filters, delta, subscriptions, exports, automatic pagination, polling, and automatic retries are blocked.

blocked.label: Draft or send mail
blocked.description: Drafts, replies, forwards, sends, recipients changes, and every other external communication are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate Outlook mail
blocked.description: Moves, archives, read-state changes, categories, rules, deletes, batch operations, and folder changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Access other Microsoft Graph data
blocked.description: Calendar, contacts, files, Teams, users, directory, administration, and non-mail Graph workloads are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw Graph access
blocked.description: Raw endpoints, arbitrary queries, beta Graph, page tokens, and CLI or MCP passthrough are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Four delegated signed-in-mailbox reads run automatically; other mailboxes, raw content, search/export, writes, other Graph workloads, and pagination remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact Mail.Read permission, signed-in /me boundary, four typed reads, privacy redaction, first-page-only behavior, and no-write invariants remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four bounded delegated Outlook reads and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens server-side.

Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.

Microsoft documents signed-in-user /me root mail-folder listing, hidden-folder exclusion by default, OData page sizing, and next links Relay does not follow.
Microsoft documents delegated Mail.Read message listing, OData select/order/filter/page parameters, and body content preferences.
